reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared getRangedAmount and getExpectedAmount helpers that every schedule amount consumer already calls.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the rule changes in one place and the rest of the diff only updates comments and tests.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the expected-amount helpers live.

scope.why: Two one-line rule changes plus matching comment and test updates.

maintainability.why: The worst-case rule is a single, well-commented min/subtract in the shared helpers, so a maintainer has one obvious place to own it.
